name: volc-agent-launchpad
description: A safety-focused Agent platform for running Codex CLI locally or on Volcengine ECS.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @launchpad/server" "npm run dev -w @launchpad/web"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:demo -w @launchpad/server" "npm run dev:local -w @launchpad/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @launchpad/shared && npm run build -w @launchpad/web && npm run build -w @launchpad/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @launchpad/shared && npm run test -w @launchpad/server && npm run test -w @launchpad/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
